Wing pattern character.reasoning: This header defines the specific morphological trait or characteristic being observed.
Wing pattern character.reasoning_relevance: The values (C1, C2, C3) represent discrete classifications of wing patterns.
Wing pattern character.basisOfRecord_reasoning: The wing pattern characters and morphometric measurements were taken from adult flies that were preserved in 100% EtOH and subsequently examined as pinned specimens.
Wing pattern character.measurementMethod: Wing measurements and character observations were performed on preserved adult specimens. Wings were carefully removed, mounted on glass slides using Euparal, and photographed using an Axiocam 208 color camera mounted on a Stemi 508 microscope. Measurements (e.g., brL, rrL, rrH, mrL) and categorical observations (C1, C2, C3) were taken using ZEN 3.6 blue edition, following the standardized proxy measurements described by Baleba et al. (2019).
